title: Wine Velvet Anarkali Suit Set with Organza Dupatta & Lace Trim
description:
A plum-wine velvet Anarkali that twirls like a dream. The deep V-neckline is framed with silver-gold lace, the high waist gives a long, graceful line, and the full flared skirt is finished with matching lace at the hem. Velvet pants and a sheer organza dupatta with lace borders complete the set. Made for winter weddings, sangeet nights, Diwali, Karwa Chauth and Christmas parties.

✦ The Details
• Wine velvet Anarkali kurta with a full flare
• V-neckline with silver-gold lace trim
• Empire (high) waist seam for a long, slim look
• Full sleeves with lace-trimmed cuffs
• Lace border at the kurta hem
• Matching velvet straight pants with lace at the hem
• Wine organza dupatta with lace on all sides
• Calf-length kurta

✦ Fabric & Craft
Soft, plush velvet with a rich sheen, lined for comfort and warmth. The dupatta is light, sheer organza that drapes beautifully over velvet. Stitched in our own Jaipur unit.

✦ Fit & Size
Fitted through the bodice with a full, flowing skirt. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Silver jhumkas, statement rings and clear heels for a sangeet or festive dinner. Add a gold potli bag and kundan studs for a wedding. Pin the dupatta on one shoulder and let it flow – or drape it over both arms for photos.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

Velvet has a natural sheen that changes with light, so the colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Dry clean only. Store on a padded hanger or folded with tissue – do not press velvet flat. Steam lightly from the inside if needed.
